description: Save, render through the platform's own renderer, and return screenshots at desktop, tablet and mobile widths, measured boxes for the bands and their children, and any layout defect measured on the render (overflow, overlap, unreadable text). node_id frames one element. Judge your work from these, not from memory.

box_depth.description: Boxes down to this depth in the tree (default 2: bands and their children)

format.description: jpeg (default) is smaller and faster; png for pixel-exact colour

node_id.description: Frame just this node instead of the whole page — how a designer looks at one card

url.description: Shoot this address instead of the draft preview — use the PUBLISHED storefront URL to see real store data

name: sb_look
